content.text_value: From Today to the Agentic Operating Model
Agentic AI reshapes every workflow stage

values.right_header: AGENTIC STATE (doing more in less time)

pairs.title: Intake
pairs.before: Requests arrive by email and are triaged by hand, often days later
pairs.after: Agents classify, enrich and route every request the moment it arrives

pairs.title: Research
pairs.before: Analysts spend days assembling context from scattered sources
pairs.after: Agents draft a sourced brief in minutes for analysts to refine

pairs.title: Decision
pairs.before: Committees wait for weekly meetings to review options
pairs.after: Owners approve pre-analysed options the same day

pairs.title: Follow-up
pairs.before: Status is chased manually across email and spreadsheets
pairs.after: Agents track progress and escalate only the exceptions

pairs.title: Customers
pairs.before: Served through a single call centre with long wait times at peak
pairs.after: Self-serve first, with agents handling complex cases

pairs.title: Operations
pairs.before: Batch processing overnight with frequent manual rework
